n: Event <Zwillingstürme im Herbst> is now open

missions: Clear ZT-8 with a 3-star rating while using Aspect of Annihilation at least 2 times
Clear ZT-10 while allowing no more than 5 Operators to be forcibly retreated due to the effects of Mark of Insipidity
Clear ZT-EX-4 while changing variations at least 4 times
Clear ZT-EX-5 while defeating at least 6 enemies without letting them activate their Resonance abilities while a variation is playing
Clear event stages 15 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 45 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 85 times, not including tutorial stages.

list: A trophy stand formed by stacking multiple large tomes. Above it stands the prized Twin Moons Trophy, bestowed upon the most exceptional knowledge-seekers. How does one reach the twin moons? The owner has propped it up high with books.
An armchair modeled after the chairs used by professors like Fremont. 'Seeing the chair reminds me of his sharp tongue. Forget sitting on it. It doesn't look all that comfortable, anyway.'
A ceiling light modeled after the university hall's large wooden ceiling fixtures. 'I came to the academy for enlightenment, and I received inspiration.'

A traditional Leithanian music box, its brass pipes lined in an ascending spiral. In dorms, it becomes the frontline of the students' battles: 'You history buffs dare add an arpeggio today, we telepaths are turning it electronic tomorrow!'

A bookshelf for music, seen throughout Ludwigs-Universität. Hauled here completely intact along with all its Leithanian music. 'I want to try putting some other genres on there. Say... rock 'n' roll, rap, and traditional Yanese music!'

A new Leithanian industrial audio device. A mechanical mechanism was added for those whose Arts are wanting. Instructions provided. 'All you need to do is press the button, and music will play automatically. You may also use Arts.'

A mysterious purple crystal once believed to hold an energy like Originium, and thus worshipped by mystics. However, after a variety of researches have all proven no truth to this claim, the only allure it has is its dark, moon-like luster.

A seat for performers to briefly rest on. One could often find famous performers holding impromptu performances on campus. Consequently, the seats they took breaks on during downtime were also commonplace.
'O Movement given life by the land, who will finally let you be heard once more?'
theme: A recreation of a Ludwigs-Universität lecture hall, based on descriptions by Lessing. The voices of knowledge-seekers echoed within these halls. 'Come forward! Step into this palace of learning!'

list:
The grandest Empresses' Celebration has come to a close. You witnessed the rebirth of Leithanien.
'I have no regrets, and I do not wonder.'
During the Zwillingstürme im Herbst event, obtain Operator Lessing.

A practitioner boards the landship.
With his sword, flesh, and mind, he shall find his ideals of virtue, power, and energy.
During the Zwillingstürme im Herbst event, spend 1800 die Klänge von den Erinnerungen in [Herbstmondeskonzert].

You have returned lost recollections to the city.
Everything that transpires under the Spires shall be remembered, and everything that emerges in the city can be heard.
'Only the Evening Glow is Forever Brilliant'
Complete all stages in [Zwillingstürme anbeten] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

You listened to Leithanien's Movement being performed once again.
The sins and suffering of the past have fallen into distant memory. Only the evening glow of Zwillingstürme is ever radiant.
Complete all the content in [Venesuhrenturm] and collect the rewards.

You answered all the requests on the Uhrturm's notice board.
The ancient clock tower will continue to sound, but the people have already learned to seek help elsewhere.
During the Zwillingstürme im Herbst event, complete 10 Routine Visitations in [Herzenfolgen].

You have visited every corner of the city.
You and the souls of the city chanced upon each other. You will never be rid of your impressions of Zwillingstürme.
During the Zwillingstürme im Herbst event, when clearing any event stage, change the Variation at least 3 times (excluding tutorials).

The melodies of Zwillingstürme are now in your hands.
How attractive is the idea of controlling this melody... Careful, for the idea can drive one to madness.
Complete all stages in [Die Gnade ist ewig] on Challenge Mode.

You reached the top of the Twin Spires, and gazed upon all of Zwillingstürme and even the entire empire.
With such an elegant view of the twenty-two cities, who wouldn't want to set foot here?
Complete all stages in [Die Macht ist grimm] on Challenge Mode.

You witnessed the end of the Pavillon.
So-called 'creations' will always crumble with time, but humanity's monument will never cease to exist.
Unlock a total of 10 different Aspects in [Herzenfolgen].

You listened to enough melodies of the heart, and everyone's emotions now echo by your ear.
There is no way someone can remain heartless when so many pieces of complex, heartfelt music have been performed.
set: Zwillingstürme im Herbst Engraved Medal Set

A set of engraved medals that depict Zwillingstürme's brilliant evening glow.
The nightmarish echoes have at last faded, and the evening glow shines upon the Twin Spires, illuminating all of Leithanien more brilliantly than hope and longer-lasting than eternity.
